CatalogueColumn.description: A column the action declares, with the grid's initial settings for it.
CatalogueColumn.title: CatalogueColumn

CatalogueParam.description: A param of an action, as the tab builds its form from it.
CatalogueParam.title: CatalogueParam

CataloguePivot.description:
How an action is offered in the grid's context menu: on one row or several, when the row
has one column from each group of alternatives.
CataloguePivot.title: CataloguePivot

EditorSchemaRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/connections/{name}/schema``: the values of the editor param's
``schemaFrom`` params, by name, without its connection param.
EditorSchemaRequest.title: EditorSchemaRequest

EditorSchemaResponse.description: What the editor completes from: ``kind`` picks the browser's adapter.
EditorSchemaResponse.title: EditorSchemaResponse

Instance.description: ``version`` changes whenever anything else here, or an installed provider, does.
Instance.title: Instance

InstanceConnection.description: A connection as the browser sees it: never its endpoint or auth.
InstanceConnection.title: InstanceConnection

KustoQueryEcho.description: Echo of the request; `requestedBy` is the token identity (read-only).
KustoQueryEcho.title: KustoQueryEcho

KustoQueryRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/kusto/query`. `requestedBy` is ignored (owner comes from the token).
KustoQueryRequest.title: KustoQueryRequest

KustoQueryRun.description: Run resource returned by POST (200/202) and GET. Server-produced only, never a request.
KustoQueryRun.title: KustoQueryRun

KustoQueryStats.description: Kusto `QueryCompletionInformation` stats. Keys are snake_case as Kusto returns them.
KustoQueryStats.title: KustoQueryStats

PatchOperation.description: One RFC 6902 operation. `move` and `copy` are rejected by the literal (400).
PatchOperation.title: PatchOperation

QueryField.description: Input field definition. `type` is a free string; `multiple` and `match` have extra rules.
QueryField.title: QueryField

QueryParam.description: Template parameter. `type` is a free string; `values` is required when `type == "array"`.
QueryParam.title: QueryParam

QueryTemplate.description: Stored/returned template. Also the target of PATCH re-validation.
QueryTemplate.title: QueryTemplate

QueryTemplateCreate.description: POST body: audit fields (`createdBy`, `updatedBy`, `updated`) are ignored if sent.
QueryTemplateCreate.title: QueryTemplateCreate

QueryTemplateReplace.description: PUT body: `uuid` must match the path; `isDeleted` and audit fields are not accepted.
QueryTemplateReplace.title: QueryTemplateReplace

Run.description:
A run without its rows. Server-produced only, never a request.

``params`` are the resolved params. ``details`` holds TIM's ``duration`` (seconds) and
``rowCount`` first, then the action's own, in the order they were reported. ``columns`` and
``rowCount`` are set once the run succeeds; ``error`` is a message safe to show.
Run.title: Run

RunColumn.description: A result column: ``declared`` by the action or the run, else inferred from the rows.
RunColumn.title: RunColumn

RunRow.description:
One result row. ``row`` is its row number, unique within the run; ``id`` is what it is
annotated by, and may repeat.
RunRow.title: RunRow

RunStatus.description: A run waiting for a concurrency slot is ``running`` too.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

SchemaResponse.description: `{schema: <parsed .show schema as json document>}`, passed through untouched.
SchemaResponse.title: SchemaResponse

StartRun.description: Body of ``POST /api/runs``. The params are validated against the action's.
StartRun.title: StartRun
